notes: Works and has very thorough tests, but adds unneeded complexity: a Remote()-comparison fallback in squashfs NewObject and New, and a symlink-only offset special case in zip Open.
Code is identical to the reference, with sensible zip, squashfs and end-to-end escape tests plus relevant docs; the zip tests do not cover range reads or a regular .rclonelink member.

Correct, but the squashfs side routes symlink handling through objectFromFileInfo and needs fallback logic in both NewObject and New; it silently gives an empty target when stat info is missing, seeking past the end errors, and the squashfs test relies on a process-global os.Chdir.

Silently drops zip members beneath symlinks even without --links instead of relying on destination refusal; adds the zip link suffix after root matching, so a root naming the .rclonelink entry fails; adds per-lookup ReadDir ancestor scans to squashfs; changes f.file semantics; and fails a hidden test.

Closely matches the reference for both backends, and newObjectNative names entries the same way List does; it also sensibly rejects non-regular entries, though the squashfs test discards one range read without asserting it.
